requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000-page yield for Black and 6,000-page yield for CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To provide higher yield bottles for cost efficiency and competitive advantage in the CISS market segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new and existing ink tanks, integration with CISS IDS.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must be keyed, deliver at least 6,000 pages for Black and CMY, and CMY bottle size must support >8,000 pages as validated by yield testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ink bottles and associated mechanisms must ensure spill-free operation during user handling and refilling.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize mess, improve customer satisfaction, and differentiate from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of bottle, tank interface, and NOA-F component.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills observed in 99.5% of user refill scenarios during testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate a NOA-F (Non-Original Authentication - Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label into the ink system, maintaining existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance security and authentication, prevent counterfeit usage, and maintain system compatibility.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with ink system, manufacturing changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F integrated, passes authentication, and is compatible with push-push and TDF mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment ink formulations without requiring reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development costs and leverage proven technology.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and tank systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink operate within performance specs in new system.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Model and characterize reliability, water vapor transmission rate (WVTR), air gain, flow rate, IDS, startup, and NOA-F end-of-life behaviors, including ink stability in tank and impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure product reliability and maintain print quality throughout product life.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires test data from new and reused components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Comprehensive models and test data validate reliability and stability meet HP standards.

requirements.Title: Support for Service/Contractual Use and Warranty Parts
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as service parts for warranty support, and system must support service/contractual business models.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure field serviceability and contractual obligations are met.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F parts availability, service process integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F available as a service part and documented in service manuals.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology onto the ink lid for enhanced functionality or security.
requirements.Rationale: To provide advanced features or authentication on the ink lid.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 present and operational on production lids.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and New Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line for NOA-F and add Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool in Orcus 5; support assembly of PHA, Dry FI, USG, and push-push in the printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: To enable efficient manufacturing of new product variants.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines modified and validated for new components and processes.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design system so that Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F can be replaced by customers without technician intervention.
requirements.Rationale: To improve serviceability and reduce total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F using provided instructions; verified in usability testing.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal (80k Pages)
requirements.Description: Increase warranty page life goal to 80,000 pages to meet new service expectations.
requirements.Rationale: To align with competitive offerings and reduce warranty claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes reliability testing for 80,000 pages under warranty conditions.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Implement Reddington ID with increased tank size; no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher ink capacity and yield without altering document feeder design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Reddington ID implemented with increased tank, passes fit and performance tests.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the product to ensure safe transport and delivery.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce shipping damage and support logistics requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes drop and vibration tests with EPS foam packaging.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To comply with environmental regulations and support market access.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes to Align with Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize overall size.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain product functionality and ergonomics with larger tanks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function without interference from tank protrusion; validated in prototype testing.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the printer for improved user interface.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance user experience and support advanced features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD integrated and passes usability and quality tests.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: To support increased ink flow and reliability with new tank design.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube supply and integration with existing components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System operates reliably with 4 Sayan Sibstar tubes and new routing in durability testing.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station aerosol management and spit platform to accommodate tank changes.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain internal cleanliness and print quality with new tank design.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station redesign, aerosol management validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol and spit management effective in 99% of tested scenarios with new tanks.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with New Weights
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force model to account for tube routing and new weights from larger tanks.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure print quality and mechanical reliability with updated system mass.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within design tolerances under new weight and routing conditions.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased page life and higher duty cycles.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliability and performance over the extended warranty and usage life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path supports at least 80,000 pages without failure in reliability testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post-80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To support extended product life and reduce service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be replaced at service centers post-80k page life.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interface (FI) connection for the Ink Delivery System (IDS), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: To support new tank design and ensure secure, reliable ink connections.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS redesign, compatibility with new bottles and tanks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS connection passes reliability and leak tests in new system.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system to ensure reliable initial operation and ongoing print quality.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize startup performance and prevent air-related print issues.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm and air management validated in 100% of initial power-on tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definitions
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion definitions to match revised page yield and warranty targets.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure customer satisfaction and accurate page yield reporting.
requirements.Dependencies: Yield and PQ testing, IDS algorithm updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ meets or exceeds defined targets at page yield endpoint in testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, and Stingray Wi-Fi Module
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, and Stingray Wi-Fi module for Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development costs and leverage proven hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components operate within performance specifications in new system integration testing.

requirements.Title: FW Dune and Security Gauss4.xx Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Dune firmware and Gauss4.xx security hardware and firmware into the platform.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure platform security and firmware compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Dune FW and Gauss4.xx security pass all system security and functional tests.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must support print speeds of 25/20 ppm (pages per minute), with PDL variant supporting 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: To meet competitive benchmarks and customer expectations for speed.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified speeds in standard benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability - Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure maintenance box is serviceable by customers to support ease of maintenance and reduce service calls.
requirements.Rationale: To lower total cost of ownership and improve customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace maintenance box following provided instructions; validated in usability testing.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate SMB management and productivity solutions, including scan, manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: To address SMB and enterprise market needs for integrated solutions.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB Customers, Enterprise IT, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB solutions operational and validated in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Print-as-a-Service) Model Support
requirements.Description: Support Print-as-a-Service (PaaS) business model, including onboarding paths for Consumer, HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Rationale: To enable recurring revenue streams and flexible customer engagement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS model operational and onboarding paths validated for all segments.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support (HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD)
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility and support for key HP client and driver software, including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: To maximize compatibility and ease of deployment for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers pass compatibility and functional testing with the new product.
